slice 3 clip-path: resolved per SVG 1.1 14.3 and CSS Masking 1 5.1/6.1 (Folio has no vector clip): a clipPath that contains everything the element paints is dropped (Ignored clip_path_noop_dropped; rectangles incl. through use of a rect, clipPathUnits userSpaceOnUse and objectBoundingBox, transform, stroke reach bounded by half width x largest scale x miter limit or square-cap diagonal, nested clip-path on the clipPath or on a child with loop (clip_path_reference_cycle) and depth-8 guards (clip_path_depth_exceeded), invalid reference = no clipping (Ignored clip_path_reference_invalid)); an empty clipPath (no child, hidden, zero-size) hides the layer (Approximated clip_path_empty_hides_element); anything else stays drawn with Unsupported clip_path_not_representable (+ clip_rule_evenodd when an unanalysed shape uses evenodd); basic shapes, file urls, unparsable values typed (unsupported_clip_path, external_clip_path_denied, clip_path_value_unparsed); definitions Ignored clip_path_definition_not_stored

slice 3 mask: identity masks dropped (Ignored mask_noop_dropped): maskUnits region (default -10%/-10%/120%/120%) and maskContentUnits, topmost opaque unstroked rect covering the element, white for mask-type luminance and any colour for alpha (mask-type as attribute or CSS, case-insensitive); empty mask, zero region and dangling reference hide the layer (Approximated mask_empty_hides_element, mask_reference_invalid_hidden per CSS Masking 1 7.1); else Unsupported mask_not_representable + mask_type_alpha|mask_type_luminance; file urls and unparsable values typed (external_mask_denied, mask_value_unparsed, unsupported_mask)

spec_and_standards_cited: SVG 1.1 13.3 patterns (inheritance via href, patternUnits/patternContentUnits defaults, viewBox overrides patternContentUnits, zero disables rendering, negative is an error, overflow hidden)
SVG 1.1 14.3 clipPath (clipPathUnits default userSpaceOnUse, children OR'd, clip-rule from the child, clip-path on clipPath/child intersects, empty clips everything)
SVG 1.1 14.4 mask (maskUnits default objectBoundingBox, -10%/-10%/120%/120%, maskContentUnits default userSpaceOnUse, value = luminance x alpha, zero region disables rendering)
SVG 2 16.1.2 circular references invalid, 16.1.6 href over xlink:href, 13.2 paint fallback for invalid references

CSS Masking 1 5.1 invalid clip-path reference clips nothing, 6.1 empty clipPath clips away the element, 7.1 invalid mask reference is a transparent black layer, 9.2 mask-type luminance|alpha (initial luminance, presentation attribute)
CSS Syntax 3 comments, strings, escapes, url tokens
decisions: no crate-local pattern/clip/mask store (ENG-DAG-FORBID-003; the earlier crate-local paint types were a debt the Folio migration repaid): exact results or typed losses only

exact results are decided with a conservative geometric proof (content control points mapped into the clip rectangle space, tight bbox by curve extrema, stroke outset bound, 1e-9 relative tolerance, finite numbers only); everything not proven is Open = typed loss and the element is not changed
definitions (pattern/clipPath/mask) are reported Ignored at the definition; what a use means is reported at the use
CSS Masking 7.1 (dangling mask = transparent black) is followed over SVG 1.1 (error) and hides the layer, reversible by setting visible; UNVERIFIED how browsers treat it today
clipPath with objectBoundingBox units AND a transform is not analysed (order of the two maps not pinned down)
unverified: order of clipPath transform and the bounding-box map (recalled from Blink, not checked in source)
browser treatment of a dangling mask reference (spec text followed)
CSS escapes in url() are not percent-decoded; an id containing % cannot be referenced
the stroke reach bound is conservative (miter limit, not true join angles): a 10 px stroke needs a 20 px margin to count as contained
